user.title: Connect to a GivEnergy device
user.description: Enter the IP of the inverter dongle, AIO or Gateway. The integration probes it and works out the model and which registers it answers. Stop GivTCP for this device first, because the dongle only serves one client at a time.

sections.title: Name and sections
sections.description:
Found **{model}** (serial {serial}, {batteries} battery pack(s)).

Entities are split into four devices. Turn off any section you don't need. It won't be polled and its entities won't be created.

- **Power**: live power flows (W) and SOC
- **Energy**: today and lifetime kWh counters
- **Controls**: modes, slots, SOC targets and limits
- **System**: status, voltages, currents, temperatures, faults and battery packs

The device name is used as the prefix for all four devices and their entity IDs.

data_description.power_interval: 10 s is plenty for dashboards. Lower values mean more traffic to the dongle.
data_description.energy_interval: kWh counters change slowly, so 60 s or more is fine.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open a TCP connection. Check the IP and that port 8899 is reachable.
error.no_response: Connected, but the device didn't answer any register reads. Another client (GivTCP?) may be holding the connection.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This device is already configured (IP updated if it changed).

init.title: GivEnergy Gateway Modbus Coms options
init.description: Turn sections on or off and set how often each one is polled. Saving reloads the integration. Entities from sections you turn off are removed.

probe_registers.name: Probe registers
probe_registers.description: Sweep every known register range on the device and report which answer. Results appear as a notification and in the service response.

config_entry.name: Device
config_entry.description: GivEnergy Gateway Modbus Coms entry to probe.

device_address.name: Device address
device_address.description: Modbus device address (17 = inverter 0x11, 50-55 = batteries). Defaults to the probed address.

write_register.name: Write register
write_register.description: Write one holding register. Only registers that the integration already exposes as controls are allowed.
